text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—Pheww! I sang my heart out! Time for a 
little break~

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, my singing really is the best! It's 
such a waste to just do solo karaoke~

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehh, no fair! I still wanna sing more~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Come to think of it, did we have 
training today?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, taking a little break won't hurt! 
After all, I'm still the strongest around♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone, gather up for karaoke! Let's 
sing and dance our hearts out!" ...And, 
send!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Hellooo? We'd like to extend our time for 
as long as possible, please!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, all set now! I'm gonna enjoy today 
to the absolute fullest!
